scope: per-SHA build checkouts on network runners (SshBuildRunner.checkout_base)
why: Unbounded per-SHA dirs filled the builder disk (23G, ENOSPC fail-blind, 2026-09-08; 46.4 GiB across 26 checkouts, 92% disk, 2026-10-20). No eviction and no pre-trigger disk read-back existed anywhere.

keep.pinned_note: A SHA is pinned only by a converged proof WITH test counts. A count-less converged report pins nothing.

evict.rule: Evict checkouts older than ttl_days except kept and pinned. Eviction is a bounded explicit action (lists paths, removes, reports freed bytes) — never silent, never a bare rm -rf without read-back.

preflight.rule: Before materializing a checkout, read back runner disk space. Below min_free_bytes the trigger reports a blocked verdict naming the disk instead of failing mid-fetch with ENOSPC.

enforcement.gate: SshBuildRunner::trigger reads the runner's free bytes before the clone and refuses with a blocked verdict
enforcement.proof: every enforcement is a CYNIC command with a read-back; no bare rm -rf

residual_unknowns: The runner-side timer that calls the eviction command on a schedule is not yet armed: the command exists and is proven, but nothing invokes it periodically. Until it is armed, eviction stays an operator-triggered action.
